args: H100: contact-map diagnostics on 1,375 validation structures
caption: Curves average over the same structures at budgets 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16 times sequence length. Unfilled slots count as misses; curves do not use native contact counts to choose the prediction budget. Calibration pools first occurrences within each rollout and is contact-weighted. Diversity and coverage are structure means; at most 128 deterministically sampled trajectory pairs measure overlap. Numbers in the coverage panel follow legend order; multiple aggregators of the same pool share calibration and diversity.
